--- /dev/null
+++ b/toolchain/bench/step42/native-parcel-lifecycle.mo
@@ -0,0 +1,354 @@
+module Bench.Step42.NativeParcelLifecycle
+expose Payload, Echo, Echoes, Deferred, Deferreds, DropTarget, DropTargets, Timer, Timers, Sink, Sinks, Exploder, Exploders, RestartTarget, RestartTargets, Queueing, Queueings, Logger, Loggers, Ender, Enders, main
+
+intent "Private Step 42 main-mode fixture: dynamic structured values cross real process safe points, while compile-time native counters distinguish one omitted Parcel destruction at a time."
+
+struct Payload
+  label: String
+  parts: List(String)
+end
+
+fn payload(label: String) : Payload
+  tail = "x".repeat(32)
+  Payload(label: "#{label}-#{tail}", parts: ["#{label}-a-#{tail}", "#{label}-b-#{tail}", "#{label}-c-#{tail}"])
+end
+
+process Echo()
+  state
+    seen: String
+  end
+
+  message RoundTrip(value: Payload) : Payload
+  message Carry(value: Payload)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      RoundTrip(value):
+        state.seen = value.label
+        Payload(label: "answer-#{value.label}", parts: value.parts.push("answer-tail-#{value.label}"))
+      Carry(value): state.seen = value.label
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Echoes
+  child Echo, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Deferred()
+  state
+    held: List(Reply(Payload))
+  end
+
+  message Hold(me: Handle(Deferred), value: Payload) : Payload
+  message Answer(value: Payload)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Hold(me, value):
+        state.held = state.held.push(reply_to)
+        me.send(Answer(value: Payload(label: "late-#{value.label}", parts: value.parts.push("late-tail"))), delay: 50.ms)
+      Answer(value):
+        for held in state.held
+          held.answer(value)
+        end
+        state.held = []
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Deferreds
+  child Deferred, restart: :never
+end
+
+process DropTarget()
+  state
+    count: UInt64
+    seen: String
+  end
+
+  invariant "Crash takes the target down before its delayed payload is due"
+    state.count < 1
+  end
+
+  message Crash(value: Payload) : Bool
+  message Carry(value: Payload)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Crash(value):
+        state.seen = value.label
+        state.count += 1
+        true
+      Carry(value): state.seen = value.label
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor DropTargets
+  child DropTarget, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Timer()
+  state
+    armed: UInt64
+  end
+
+  message Arm(target: Handle(DropTarget), value: Payload) : Bool
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Arm(target, value):
+        target.send(Carry(value: value), delay: 1.seconds)
+        state.armed += 1
+        true
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Timers
+  child Timer, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Sink()
+  state
+    seen: List(String)
+  end
+
+  message Store(value: Payload)
+  message Seen : List(String)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Store(value): state.seen = state.seen.push(value.label)
+      Seen: state.seen
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Sinks
+  child Sink, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Exploder()
+  state
+    count: UInt64
+    held: List(Reply(Payload))
+  end
+
+  invariant "the transaction rolls back instead of committing one"
+    state.count < 1
+  end
+
+  message Explode(sink: Handle(Sink), value: Payload) : Payload
+  message Count : UInt64
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Explode(sink, value):
+        state.held = state.held.push(reply_to)
+        sink.send(Store(value: Payload(label: "outbox-#{value.label}", parts: value.parts.push("outbox-tail"))))
+        for held in state.held
+          held.answer(Payload(label: "answer-#{value.label}", parts: value.parts.push("answer-tail")))
+        end
+        state.held = []
+        state.count += 1
+      Count: state.count
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Exploders
+  child Exploder, restart: :always
+end
+
+process RestartTarget()
+  state
+    count: UInt64
+    seen: List(String)
+  end
+
+  invariant "the first queued message crashes before the trailing one"
+    state.count < 1
+  end
+
+  message Crash(value: Payload)
+  message Trailing(value: Payload)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Crash(value):
+        state.seen = state.seen.push(value.label)
+        state.count += 1
+      Trailing(value): state.seen = state.seen.push(value.label)
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor RestartTargets
+  child RestartTarget, restart: :always
+end
+
+process Queueing()
+  state
+    queued: UInt64
+  end
+
+  message Queue(target: Handle(RestartTarget), value: Payload) : Bool
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Queue(target, value):
+        target.send(Crash(value: value))
+        target.send(Trailing(value: Payload(label: "trailing-#{value.label}", parts: value.parts.push("trailing-tail"))))
+        state.queued += 2
+        true
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Queueings
+  child Queueing, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Logger()
+  state
+    labels: List(String)
+  end
+
+  message Record(value: Payload)
+  message Values : List(String)
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Record(value): state.labels = state.labels.push(value.label)
+      Values: state.labels
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Loggers
+  child Logger, restart: :never
+end
+
+process Ender(started: Payload)
+  state
+    seen: String
+  end
+
+  message Observe(value: Payload) : Payload
+
+  fn update(state, message)
+    case message
+      Observe(value):
+        state.seen = value.label
+        Payload(label: "#{started.label}|#{value.label}", parts: started.parts.concat(value.parts))
+    end
+  end
+end
+
+supervisor Enders
+  child Ender, restart: :never
+end
+
+fn waiter(out: Out)
+  expected = payload("waiter")
+  case Echo.start().ask(RoundTrip(value: expected), within: 1.minute)
+    Ok(got) if got.label == "answer-#{expected.label}" and got.parts == expected.parts.push("answer-tail-#{expected.label}"):
+      out.write_line("waiter: dynamic payload returned")
+    _: out.write_line("waiter: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn timeout(out: Out)
+  held = Deferred.start()
+  case held.ask(Hold(me: held, value: payload("timeout")), within: 1.ms)
+    Error(Timeout): out.write_line("timeout: Error(Timeout)")
+    _: out.write_line("timeout: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn due_down(out: Out)
+  target = DropTarget.start()
+  armed = Timer.start().ask(Arm(target: target, value: payload("due")), within: 1.minute)
+  crashed = target.ask(Crash(value: payload("down")), within: 1.minute)
+  if armed is Ok(true) and crashed is Error(Down)
+    out.write_line("due-down: armed then Down")
+  else
+    out.write_line("due-down: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn exit_later(platform: Platform)
+  target = DropTarget.start()
+  armed = Timer.start().ask(Arm(target: target, value: payload("exit-later")), within: 1.minute)
+  platform.stdout.write_line("exit-later: #{armed}")
+  platform.exit(3)
+end
+
+fn push_after_exit(platform: Platform)
+  target = Echo.start()
+  platform.stdout.write_line("push-after-exit: scheduled after exit")
+  platform.exit(4)
+  target.send(Carry(value: payload("after-exit")), delay: 3_600_000.ms)
+end
+
+fn crash_transaction(out: Out)
+  sink = Sink.start()
+  worker = Exploder.start()
+  crashed = worker.ask(Explode(sink: sink, value: payload("crash")), within: 1.minute)
+  rolled_back = worker.ask(Count, within: 1.minute)
+  case sink.ask(Seen, within: 1.minute)
+    Ok(seen) if crashed is Error(Down) and rolled_back is Ok(0) and seen == []:
+      out.write_line("crash-transaction: Down, rolled back, sink untouched")
+    _: out.write_line("crash-transaction: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn restart_drop(out: Out)
+  target = RestartTarget.start()
+  queued = Queueing.start().ask(Queue(target: target, value: payload("restart")), within: 1.minute)
+  platform_result = if queued is Ok(true): "queued" else: "wrong"
+  out.write_line("restart-drop: #{platform_result}")
+end
+
+fn log_eviction(out: Out)
+  logger = Logger.start()
+  var expected = []
+  for i in 0..16
+    value = payload("log-#{i}")
+    logger.send(Record(value: value))
+    expected = expected.push(value.label)
+  end
+  case logger.ask(Values, within: 1.minute)
+    Ok(labels) if labels == expected: out.write_line("log-eviction: all 16 dynamic labels retained")
+    _: out.write_line("log-eviction: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn ended(out: Out)
+  started = payload("start")
+  logged = payload("log")
+  case Ender.start(started).ask(Observe(value: logged), within: 1.minute)
+    Ok(got) if got.label == "#{started.label}|#{logged.label}" and got.parts == started.parts.concat(logged.parts):
+      out.write_line("end: dynamic start and log survived")
+    _: out.write_line("end: wrong result")
+  end
+end
+
+fn main(platform: Platform)
+  case platform.args.first or ""
+    "waiter": waiter(platform.stdout)
+    "timeout": timeout(platform.stdout)
+    "due-down": due_down(platform.stdout)
+    "exit-later": exit_later(platform)
+    "push-after-exit": push_after_exit(platform)
+    "crash-transaction": crash_transaction(platform.stdout)
+    "restart-drop": restart_drop(platform.stdout)
+    "log-eviction": log_eviction(platform.stdout)
+    "end": ended(platform.stdout)
+    _:
+      platform.stderr.write_line("use waiter|timeout|due-down|exit-later|push-after-exit|crash-transaction|restart-drop|log-eviction|end")
+      platform.exit(2)
+  end
+end

Zig design:
- ParcelAudit belongs to one Vm; no global baseline. Atomic allocated/destroyed counters make scheduler-thread destruction safe.
- Vm and Parcel carry audit/allocator fields only as builtin.is_test conditional types. Non-test ordinary, stress, and ASan builds compile them to void and compile away all audit branches.
- Vm.pack records allocation immediately after successful Parcel creation and before copyOut. Parcel.free records destruction. The existing errdefer therefore balances a copyOut allocation failure.
- Test allocator injection is likewise builtin.is_test only. No public Mo API, environment setting, CLI, or production hook.
Focused errdefer control:
- Installed Zig metadata identifies Zig 0.16.0 and std.testing.FailingAllocator.init(backing, .{ .fail_index = 1 }). Allocation index 0 creates Parcel; index 1 is copyOut's first Arena allocation and is induced to fail.
- Planned command: `bash -c 'set -o pipefail; python3 bench/step36/guard.py 600 -- zig build test -Dtest-filter="pack frees its parcel when copying the payload runs out of memory" --summary all 2>&1 | tee bench/step42/safety-evidence/pack-errdefer-green.log; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; printf "%s\n" "$rc" > bench/step42/safety-evidence/pack-errdefer-green.exit; exit "$rc"'`.
- Before any allocator or Parcel balance assertion, the test prints raw `step42 pack-errdefer allocator allocations=N deallocations=N allocated_bytes=N freed_bytes=N` and `step42 parcel-audit case=pack-errdefer allocated=N destroyed=N live=N` lines. Green must then return OutOfMemory, set has_induced_failure, require allocator allocations=1/deallocations=1 and allocated_bytes=freed_bytes, and require ParcelAudit allocated=1/destroyed=1/live=0.

The test and std.testing allocator leak check fail. Restore and rerun green.
Native design:
- MO_TEST_PARCEL_AUDIT alone enables process-local C11 atomic counters at actual pack/parcel_free and one final stderr line: `MO_TEST_PARCEL_AUDIT allocated=N destroyed=N live=N`.
- At quiescent program end, only under MO_TEST_PARCEL_AUDIT, mo_program_end calls the existing production sweep after Mo main's frames are gone. This makes real end_process start/log destruction observable rather than treating OS exit as a destructor.

Production paths:
- Direct send: Forward update creates the outbox value; commit moves it to mailbox; delivery raises ticks from 0 to 1.
